en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large brick building surrounded by a park-like setting with trees, paths, and benches. The building has ornate architectural details and based on the caption below the image, it is identified as 'Flickskolan', which means 'girls' school'. Handwritten Swedish text covers part of the front. On the reverse, the card is labeled 'BREFKORT' (old Swedish for 'postcard'), carries a Swedish stamp, and is addressed to Umeå.
